About me

One coder, many loves

I'm FARHAN, and online I'm CODER_27. I like building things in code and on the web, keeping up with mobile phones and electronic gadgets, and playing games offline.

Away from the keyboard it's movies, music, and cricket along with every other sport I can follow. This website is a project I'm building to grow my web development skills, and every section here is something I'm working on or have already made.

Hall of Armor

      
Every suit from my chart: Mark 1 to Mark 50, plus Mark 85. Tap any suit for a closer look. The name under each photo is the one printed on the chart. The short notes only say which film a suit appears in and what is printed on the chart, because I could not confirm finer details; where the chart may differ from other lists, the suit says so.

      Sources & accuracy
      
      
      Facts last verified 3 Nov 2026. ✓ means a fact was confirmed by at least one more source than Wikipedia. Anything I could not confirm is left out or marked “Not verified”, never guessed.
      
      
        
        
      • Stats are snapshots. Every table shows its “as of” date, and players who are still active will have newer numbers.
        • 
        
      • Club and international numbers are kept apart. Formats and competitions are never mixed into one total.
        • 
        
      • Facts and opinions are separate. Playing-style notes are marked as editorial opinion.
        • 
        
      • “MVP” is this page’s own label, not an official award. This is an unofficial fan page, not connected to any player, club or board. Photos were supplied by the site owner and belong to their original photographers and rights holders.

      HORIZON RACER 3D
      
      
      Chase the glowing horizon through a neon night city, dodge barriers and traffic, grab energy cells and survive every stage. It runs in real 3D on your device.

      HORIZON
      RACER 3D
      
          
      Steer, dodge and out-run the dark. Three armor points, endless stages.
      
          
      
            
      TouchDrag a finger on the road to steer, or use the round arrow buttons. Hold GAS to speed up and BRAKE to slow down.
      
            
      KeyboardA / D or arrows steer. W / Up is gas, S / Down is brake. P, Space or Esc pauses.

      Real 3D scene with a chase camera, collisions, five colour stages, Night, Sunset and Rain scenes, three graphics levels and a best score saved on this device.Speed lines and a field-of-view kick give the feeling of motion. There is no true motion blur.The KM/H number is a game value, not a real speed. There are no player names, online leaderboard or multiplayer: the best score is stored only in this browser.
